body: Additional immediate leads: setup wizard should explicitly guide Windows users to Win+P -> Extend (not Duplicate) so audience display and private presenter console can differ; Win+Shift+Left/Right moves the active window between monitors; Win+K opens Miracast casting. Microsoft sources: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/keyboard-shortcuts-in-windows-dcc61a57-8ff0-cffe-9796-cb9706c75eec and https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/screen-mirroring-and-projecting-to-your-pc-or-wireless-display-5af9f371-c704-1c7f-8f0d-fa607551d09c. Cognitive accessibility direction: wizard and live console should use clear purpose, familiar hierarchy, explicit control-to-content relationships, short critical paths, limited interruptions, undo, and avoid relying on memory; W3C COGA: https://www.w3.org/TR/coga-usable/. Product implication: keep the live console to Now / Next / Signals, with setup/report outside the live workspace.
summary: Windows display and cognitive-load UX leads
